Requirement: Desktop client supports corporate Windows 10/11 editions approved by the company.
Target: Windows 10/11; supported .NET LTS build

Requirement: All primary and destructive actions have keyboard-only paths.
Target: 100% critical flows keyboard-completable

Requirement: Focus is visible, order is deterministic, controls have accessible names and states.
Target: No critical WCAG/Windows accessibility blocker

Requirement: Layouts remain usable at 100–200% Windows scaling and multiple monitors.
Target: No clipped critical control at 200%

Requirement: Status/urgency/error is never communicated by color alone.
Target: Text/icon/state alternative for every colored signal

Requirement: Large lists use server pagination and client virtualization.
Target: No full dataset load; stable interaction on source scale

Requirement: Calendar reads are range-bounded and virtualized.
Target: No unbounded multi-year query

Requirement: Filtering and cursor pagination execute server-side before result delivery.
Target: No client post-filter of paged results

Requirement: Server outage changes application to honest read-only cache mode.
Target: 0 accepted business writes while API unavailable

Requirement: After reconnect client authenticates, applies change feed, and bootstraps when cursor/scope is invalid.
Target: No stale unauthorized projection after recovery

Requirement: Versioned writes require If-Match and reject stale/missing version.
Target: 100% versioned writes covered by 412/428/409 tests

Requirement: Idempotent commands do not duplicate side effects for same key/hash.
Target: Exactly one business result/event for duplicate delivery

Requirement: Server evaluates authentication, capability and relation on every request.
Target: No authorization decision based solely on UI

Requirement: Tokens, passwords, secrets and sensitive full paths are absent from logs/analytics.
Target: 0 secret findings in log scan

Requirement: Client-server traffic uses approved TLS inside local network.
Target: No plaintext API endpoint

Requirement: User-specific cache is encrypted, disposable and cleared on logout/revoke/scope changes as specified.
Target: No readable cache after cleanup

Requirement: Client displays stable recovery message and traceId without stack trace.
Target: All stable errors mapped; no raw exception

Requirement: Application never deletes or moves physical working files as a metadata side effect.
Target: 0 physical mutations in delete/move/purge tests

Requirement: OS/SMB ACL remains authoritative and failures are categorized.
Target: No ACL bypass; differentiated error

Requirement: Unsupported client is blocked with 426/update route.
Target: No writable shell below min version

Requirement: Audit/history is append-only and authorization/redaction aware.
Target: No update/delete path for audit; current-right filtering

Requirement: Admin UI shows backup result, last success and verification status; backup bytes are not exposed.
Target: No success claim without completed result/verification metadata

Requirement: Candidate is designed for up to 300 active employees, 100 concurrent connections and approximately 2M tasks/events.
Target: Architecture target; validate with load fixtures

Requirement: Working-hours target 99.5%, RPO ≤15 min, RTO ≤4 h are architecture assumptions, not contractual SLA.
Target: Measure and confirm before production baseline

Requirement: Requests, text and batch sizes respect OpenAPI/Stage 2.2 limits.
Target: 0 client request beyond contract limit
